findings.title: The engine's commit check allows every unowned vendored change when git runs it from a hook in a linked worktree
An in-tree overlayDir that links outside the repository skips the outside-repository refusal

traceability.summary: outside-repo refusal matches phase 006; its limitation 1 predicts refuse where the code allows

novelty: New P1 reproduced end to end (pre-commit exit 1 without GIT_DIR, exit 0 allow with it) and one P2 containment gap; prior R1-P2-001 sibling variant and R13-P2-001 verified fixed.

ledger.hypothesis: hook-exported GIT_DIR makes the commit check see no vendored changes
ledger.result: reproduced: allow with GIT_DIR, refuse without

ledger.hypothesis: an in-tree link escapes the repository check
ledger.result: containment check only in the sibling branch

ledger.hypothesis: ../.git or an outside sibling is still accepted
ledger.result: refused by the git top-level check

ruledOut.reason: git exports no GIT_DIR there; engine refuses
